risks.title: Dependence on key customers
risks.summary: The loss or reduction of business with a major customer could significantly impact revenues.
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned in the context of sales concentrated among a few major customers. Significant exposure to major airlines and defense customers represents a material risk. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Intense technological competition
risks.summary: Competitive pressure requires constant innovation to maintain market share.
risks.score_rationale: Ranked high in the 10-K with mention of major competitors (Honeywell, RTX, etc.) and risk of customers becoming competitors. Language emphasizes innovation as a critical differentiator. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Mandatory regulatory certifications
risks.summary: Lack of certification can prevent product sales in critical markets.
risks.score_rationale: Presented as a barrier to entry but also a major operational risk in aerospace and industrial sectors. Language intensity emphasizes safety and regulatory compliance requirements. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Cyberattacks or IT intrusions
risks.summary: A major cyberattack could disrupt operations, compromise data or damage reputation.
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited in forward-looking statements as potentially impacting financial condition, results and reputation. Strong language and existential risk for an IT/industrial company. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risks related to international operations
risks.summary: Trade, tariff or geopolitical tensions can affect the supply chain and costs.
risks.score_rationale: Repeated mention of risks related to tariffs, global supply chain and foreign markets. Explicit concern regarding the evolution of US-China trade policy and its impact on the industrial segment. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on raw material suppliers
risks.summary: Unavailability or rising prices of raw materials can impact margin and production.
risks.score_rationale: Cited in forward-looking statements as a supply risk. Moderate language, but context of inflation and tight supply chains reinforces its relevance. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Acquisition integration
risks.summary: Failure to integrate an acquisition can result in additional costs and operational disruptions.
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in forward-looking statements as a risk that could affect results. Preventive but serious language, typical of major strategic risks. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: WWD does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K report.
